title: Fire prevention and fire protection.
officialText: Firefighting equipment, fire fighting access at the construction or demolition site, and the conduct of all construction or demolition operations affecting fire prevention and fire fighting shall comply with the New York City Fire Code and the provisions of Sections 3303.7.1 through 3303.7.5.
